sidebar.title: Panel Assistant
sidebar.failed: The panel could not be opened. It will be tried again shortly.
sidebar.admin: An administrator must open this page.
sidebar.unreachableBody: Home Assistant cannot reach this panel right now.
sidebar.notLoadedBody: This panel is not loaded in Home Assistant.
sidebar.picklesStory: Pickles the panda has escaped and is causing havoc. He’s slow and stubborn, so getting him back may take a moment.
sidebar.unreachableNext: Check that the panel is powered on and connected to your network.
sidebar.notLoadedNext: Open Integration settings to check this panel’s connection.
sidebar.failedNext: Wait a moment while we try again, or choose another panel.
sidebar.closedNext: Choose another panel, or wait for this panel to reconnect.

haInstall.title: Install ha-paneld on a panel
haInstall.introduction: Plug the panel into this computer with a USB cable. A new window will find it and install the app.
haInstall.catalogError: The list of versions couldn’t be loaded.
haInstall.empty: No versions are available yet. Try again later.
haInstall.unavailable: The installer isn’t available. Update Panel Assistant, then try again.
haInstall.admin: Ask a Home Assistant administrator to install panels.
haInstall.popup_blocked: Your browser blocked the new window. Allow pop-ups for this page, then press Continue.
haInstall.failed: That didn’t work. Press Continue to try again.

installer.title: Set up your panel
installer.preparingSlow: Still getting the app ready. Keep the Home Assistant tab open.
installer.connectBody: Plug the panel into this computer with a USB cable, then press Find my panel.
installer.allowBody: Look at the panel’s screen and tap Allow.
installer.confirmBody: This installs the app and makes it your panel’s home screen. Your other apps are not touched.
installer.restartedDifferentVersion: An earlier installation attempt used a different release. That attempt has been set aside.
installer.alreadyInstalledBody: This version is already on your panel. Continue to finish setting it up; nothing is copied or reinstalled.
installer.stepCopying: Copying the app to your panel…
installer.stepPermissions: Giving the app what it needs to run…
installer.keepConnected: Keep the cable plugged in until this finishes.
installer.doneOpening: Taking you to your panel’s setup…
installer.doneManual: Finish setting up on the panel’s screen.
installer.unsupported: This browser can’t talk to USB devices. Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
installer.handoffFailure: The app couldn’t be fetched from Home Assistant. Go back to Home Assistant and start again.
installer.noSelection: No panel was chosen. Press Find my panel and pick it from the list, or try another cable: some cables power the panel but carry no data.
installer.connectionTimeout: The panel didn’t answer. Check the cable is firmly in, or swap it: a cable can power the panel and still carry no data.
installer.disconnected: The panel was disconnected. Plug it back in, wait for it to start, then press Try again.

errors.installErrorGeneric: Something went wrong. Keep the panel plugged in and press Try again.
errors.installErrorBusy: The panel is busy with another install. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.installErrorStorage: This browser couldn’t save its progress. Allow this site to store data, then try again.
errors.installErrorTarget: A different panel was connected. Plug in the same panel and try again.
errors.installErrorArtifact: The app download couldn’t be checked. Go back to Home Assistant and start again.
errors.installErrorNotClean: This panel already has the app. Update it from Home Assistant instead.
errors.installErrorIncompatible: This panel can’t run this version of the app.
errors.installErrorConnection: The connection to the panel dropped. Keep it plugged in and press Try again.
errors.installErrorHealth: The app is installed but hasn’t started yet. Wait a moment, then try again.

support.copiedDetail: {bytes} bytes sent; waiting for the panel to confirm
support.setupMissing: not found; setup continues on the panel
